pendentes.titulo: Computador para arquitetura: o que AutoCAD, Revit e SketchUp pedem
pendentes.alt: Mesa de trabalho com um computador de mesa preto, monitor apagado, régua e plantas de papel enroladas ao lado
pendentes.pedido: A tidy architect's desk seen from a slight side angle: a black mid-tower desktop computer standing on the floor beside the desk, a large switched-off monitor on the desk, rolled paper blueprints tied with a rubber band, a metal ruler and a small white architectural scale model of a house. Keyboard pushed to the back and out of focus. Soft natural daylight from a window on the left, neutral grey and wood tones.

pendentes.titulo: TeamViewer 15.83 corrige três falhas graves: veja quem precisa atualizar
pendentes.alt: Notebook preto fechado sobre uma mesa de escritório, ao lado de um monitor apagado visto de lado e de um roteador com luzes acesas
pendentes.pedido: A quiet home office desk seen from a low side angle. A closed black plastic laptop with a thick bezel rests on the wooden desk. Behind it, a switched-off desktop monitor is turned slightly away from the camera. A small generic Wi-Fi router with tiny green status lights sits at the edge of the desk. Soft evening light from a window on the right, shallow depth of field.

pendentes.titulo: Windows Update parado na mesma porcentagem: esperar ou reiniciar?
pendentes.alt: Computador de mesa ligado sobre uma escrivaninha, com o monitor de lado mostrando uma tela azul desfocada e a luz do gabinete acesa
pendentes.pedido: A black desktop computer tower standing on a wooden desk next to a monitor turned at a steep angle away from the camera, its screen glowing with a soft blurred blue color and no readable content. A small white activity light glows on the front of the tower. A coffee mug and a closed notebook rest on the desk. Evening light from a desk lamp, calm and quiet atmosphere, shallow depth of field.

pendentes.titulo: Notebook para usar IA: o que olhar antes de comprar
pendentes.alt: Notebook preto de plástico fechado sobre uma mesa de trabalho de madeira, ao lado de um caderno e de uma caneca, com luz natural da janela
pendentes.pedido: A closed black plastic laptop with a thick body resting on a light wooden desk, seen from a three-quarter angle. Beside it, a closed paper notebook and a ceramic coffee mug. A small potted plant slightly out of focus in the background. Soft natural daylight coming from a window on the left, calm home office atmosphere.

pendentes.titulo: Windows 11 libera menu do botão direito personalizável na KB5127936
pendentes.alt: Computador de mesa com o gabinete preto sobre uma escrivaninha de madeira, monitor apagado ao lado e um mouse em primeiro plano
pendentes.pedido: A black mid-tower desktop computer case standing on a light wooden desk, next to a switched-off monitor seen at an angle. A plain black wired mouse rests on a gray mouse pad in the foreground, in sharp focus. A small potted plant at the edge of the desk. Soft afternoon daylight from a window on the right, shallow depth of field.
